assumptions: One bounded allocation component record per accepted software requirement (XDL1-SR-001-CMP .. XDL1-SR-019-CMP) following the accepted capability record convention (T027/T038), so that later decomposes_to/implemented_by/verified_by/analyzed_by links stay unambiguous; the module decomposition XDL1-ARCH-01..10 is documented in architecture.md section 4 and referenced from each record.

The typed Profile extension is limited to the attachments the accepted core already exposes (Scenario /extensions, spec.steps[i]/extensions, spec.faults[i]/extensions, spec.bindings[i]/extensions); no new extension container or top-level kind is added.

Profile identity is frozen explicitly (namespace io.xverse.experiment, payload schemaVersion 0.1, Profile metadata.version 0.1.0, schemaRef https://xverse.io/profiles/experiment-lite/v0.1/schema.json, file xdl/profiles/experiment-lite-v0.1.schema.json) because the admitted planning inputs deliberately left field names, versions and bounds to detailed design.

The deterministic destination for declared System core parameters is a dedicated always-present System-scope entry in the plan components[] array (scope='system', emitted first); this keeps the projection inside the components[].declaredParameters surface named by XDL1-SR-002 while remaining deterministic and non-duplicating for Systems with several component instances.

Physical realization is explicitly unsupported in Phase 1 because Phase 1 holds no device or artifact-admission authority and executes nothing; simulated, virtual and hybrid declarations are recorded as references only.
Run identity and wall-clock generation time live only in a volatile envelope outside the plan body; byte-level source hashes stay volatile and only normalized semantic digests enter the plan.

engineering/trace/links.json is a mutable additive trace file: 19 allocated_to links (XDL1-L-101 .. XDL1-L-119) were appended to the 3044 pre-existing links and the rewrite was verified byte-idempotent over the preserved entries; the file is not listed as an immutable artifact of this stage.
Scientific protocol values (thresholds, tolerances, deadlines, repetitions, margins, seeds, campaign parameters) remain caller inputs and none is chosen, defaulted, or narrowed by this design.
No implementation, schema, fixture, or test code was written in this stage; the precode gate requires the unit-specification and verification-design stages to complete first.
findings: XDL1-RVW-001 resolved at the contract level: detailed-design.md section 10.3 freezes three explicit max_parameters scopes (per declared payload list, total compiled parameters by the deterministic C_total rule, and declared core parameter lists) and section 6 places the total-scope check over the finished sections before identity finalization; every scope violation emits XDL1-PLAN-BOUND-EXCEEDED and returns no plan. Implementation and executed negative evidence are owned by later stages and are not claimed.

XDL1-RVW-002 resolved at the contract level: detailed-design.md decisions XDL1-DD-14, the section 5 mapping rows and the section 7 field rules freeze an always-present components[scope='system'] entry as the deterministic, non-duplicating destination for System.spec.parameters (and System.spec.models), while Component.spec.parameters remains on that Component's component-instance entry.

XDL1-RVW-003 closed by obligation only: detailed-design.md section 10.3 and section 17 require at least one independent negative case per declared bound scope, explicitly including the total compiled-parameter scope, bound into XDL1-UNIT and XDL1-VALIDATION by the verification-design stage. No test exists yet; the obligation is a hand-off, not evidence.
